_help: Describe the data flows of your AI agent system. Use null for 'not known yet': the pack will print an [OPEN] marker and list the question. Never put a client's or person's real data in this file. Allowed values are listed in the _help keys; see examples/dd_harness.json for a filled example.

controller._help: role: controller | processor | both (towards clients). country: ISO code, e.g. TR, DE.
controller.name: My firm

data._help: kind: ordinary | contact | id_number | financial | special (Art. 9) | criminal (Art. 10) | minor
data.label: Names and contact details

activities._help: source: data_subject | client | public | third_party | generated. lawful_basis: 6(1)(a)...6(1)(f). art9_condition e.g. 9(2)(f).
activities.name: Main purpose

agents._help: models: vendor ids of the language models; vendors: other vendors the agent sends data to. output: internal | client | court | published
agents.name: Agent

vendors._help: role: processor | sub_processor | controller | joint_controller | none. country: ISO code or LOCAL. receives: raw | masked | metadata | none. dpa: signed | accepted_online | available | none. transfer_mechanism: adequacy | dpf | scc | bcr | derogation | none
vendors.name: Model vendor

storage._help: vendor: id of the vendor hosting it (a LOCAL vendor for your own computer)

ai._help: role: deployer | provider | both. annex_iii: [] if none; areas: employment, credit, insurance, justice, migration, biometric, education, essential_services, law_enforcement
